title: Quotient and remainder of a stride encoding
statement: Let $M$ be a Turing machine with $k(M)$ states, and let $N,T,t,o$ be natural numbers. Define the stride $s=k(M)(2T+1)+N+3$. If $o<s$, then dividing $ts+o$ by $s$ gives quotient $t$ and remainder $o$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a Turing machine over Boolean symbols
